purpose: Catalog historical multi-source projection archives that may help source discovery and residual research but have not yet cleared FSFFL preseason-freeze and rights gates.
admission_rule: Repository presence or a historical filename is not sufficient. Each provider-season-position projection set must independently prove contemporaneous preseason timing, raw-stat meaning, source identity/independence, and permitted intended use before authoritative calibration.

archives.archive_note: Repository contains historical projection CSV/RData files assembled from multiple third-party providers. Package documentation states historical projection scraping is generally difficult and supports scraping multiple analysts/sources.
blocked_reasons: Original provider snapshot timestamps have not been independently established for each file.
Repository availability does not establish reuse rights for embedded third-party projection data.
Aggregate files may contain multiple analysts/providers and must not be treated as independent source votes without de-duplication.
Schema/raw-stat comparability has not yet been audited provider by provider.
permitted_current_use: non-authoritative ensemble-method prototyping with explicit research-only labels

next_qualification_steps: Inspect file metadata and commit history for earliest repository availability.
Identify provider-specific update dates or contemporaneous publication evidence.
Map raw stat columns and scoring-derived columns separately.
Confirm analyst/provider independence to avoid duplicated source families.
Review intended-use rights separately for personal research and commercial deployment.
Admit only provider-season-position slices that clear every gate into historical_projection_source_inventory.json.
